Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game. We had five days of attritional cricket and it turned out to be a very exciting finish, one which just shows why Test cricket is still the best format. A fair result in the end and now it is all to play for in the second and final Test between the two teams. It starts on the 16th of October in Abu Dhabi at 1000 local (0600 GMT). Do join us then. Cheers!

Australia captain, Tim Paine, calls it a tough match. Feels that his team played some outstanding cricket and is very proud to achieve a draw in the end. Admits that they had made some plans during the first innings, but they experienced a bit of a collapse and failed to put up a good total. Is proud of the efforts of his boys in the second innings. Again admits that he was very nervous in the last hour. Feels that on such a pitch, when a batsman gets set, it becomes much easier to stay out there longer. States that the Pakistan bowlers were really good and during that last hour even one wicket would have been enough for them to run through their batting. When asked if this draw feels like a win, a humble Tim Paine replies no and admits the fact that they were outplayed. Further adds that the result has given him immense happiness because of the way they fought.

Pakistan captain, Sarfraz Ahmed, says he hoped to win this Test after a great performance on the first three days but credits Usman Khawaja for the way he batted today. Feels the Aussie opener was the one who saved the match. Mentions about the amazing reverse sweep shots that Khawaja played which he feels was a really good solution to counter the rough patches outside the off stump. States that in Test cricket you learn as you play more games. Regarding the positive points he can take from the match, the Pakistan captain credits how Mohammad Abbas bowled throughout the game. Adds that his stint in County cricket in England has really helped him improve his game. Also praises the way some of his other players played. Ends by saying that they could have won the match but Test cricket is such that if your opponents play so well, then you have to give them credit.

Man of the Match, Usman Khawaja, says that he was just thinking to bat as long as possible. Feels that the pitch was getting tougher and tougher as the game went ahead. Informs that as a team they thought that if they are able to cope well in the first and second sessions today, then they will have a good chance of saving this Test. Also credits Pakistan for a great match and their sportsman spirit. Mentions that such an innings to save a match means a lot to him. Regarding the reverse sweep, the southpaw says that as a left-hander he had to cope with the rough outside his off stump, hence he needed to come up with plans to counter it.

Day 5 saw a new hero emerge for the Kangaroos. Usman Khawaja, who has faced so much criticism in the past, silenced all his critics in some style. Yes, he was given a life by Asad Shafiq but take nothing away from the southpaw's innings. He, along with Travis Head, first chewed up 292 balls for the 4th wicket and then combined with his skipper Tim Paine to battle out another 220 deliveries. The Islamabad-born man got to his first ton in Asia and broke several records in the process. He would be a shade disappointed for not lasting the distance. However, his skipper and the lower order batsmen ensured his knock does not go in vain as they salvaged a draw for the visitors. A word of praise for the Aussie skipper again, he had a great game behind the stumps and then showed his ability with the bat when his team was in dire straits.

After deciding not to enforce the follow-on, which many can now say cost them the game, Pakistan built on their advantage and with contributions from quite a few of their batsmen, they took their lead close to 500. With around five sessions to negotiate, once again Aaron Finch and Usman Khawaja started off well putting together an 87-run partnership. But post that the devil's number struck the Aussies and they lost three wickets on the same score.

Pakistan though would be very disappointed. They had this game in the bag but failed to capitalize on the final day. Firstly, they posted a huge first innings score, courtesy Hafeez and Sohail's century. Then, after Finch and Khawaja gave the ideal start to Australia in the first innings by adding a huge 142-run stand, the virtual hosts bounced back in some style. Bilal Asif, the debutant, and Mohammad Abbas did all the damage and helped Pakistan gain a huge 280-run lead.

We entered into the final session with Pakistan needing five wickets and Australia needing to play out 31 overs. The first hour, like most the of the hours today, belonged to the Aussies. Usman Khawaja and Tim Paine grinded it out and when the two were batting, the only result which looked possible was a draw. However, the game came to life in the last hour. In fact, Yasir Shah came to life in the last hour. He got rid of the centurion and then took two in one over to turn the tide in Pakistan's favour. Australia had only two wickets left with more than 10 overs to go but the resolute Tim Paine and Nathan Lyon showed tremendous character and ensured the Aussies do not go one down in the series.

The game ends in a DRAW! What a monumental achievement for Australia. Not many gave them a chance of batting out the whole day today but they have risen against the odds and have managed to do so. Kudos to Tim Paine, what a time to deliver. The Australian skipper walks off to a standing ovation and he deserves every bit of it.

IT'S A DRAW! Everyone is nervous as Yasir bowls a flighted ball on middle and off. Paine watchfully defends it. A magnificent effort by the skipper as he comes up with a perfect captain's knock to save this Test match. The Australian balcony is delighted. Now, we are seeing the players shaking hands in the middle. That's it then.

Oh! The outer half of the bat found here but it flies past the second slip fielder. It went straight down onto the ground though. Now just 2 more to go. Pakistan will have to strike on the next ball...
Yasir gives this a bit more air, hoping for some extra spin and bounce. The Australian captain though is up to it as he defends it with a dead straight bat onto the ground off the front foot.
This one is a flighted ball and full on off, Paine does really well to drive it through long off and get another brace. You should never miss out on Test runs, they never come easy.

The first one is a tossed up ball around off, spinning away. Paine looks to block it off the front foot but it takes the outer half of his bat and runs down to third man. The batsman start running and that gives a lot of tension to the Australian dressing room. Luckily for the Aussies, the batsmen are able to come back for a brace. Paine is still on strike.
6 balls remaining. It has all boiled down to this. Yasir Shah has the ball in hand. An umbrella field there. Pressure everywhere.

Three poor deliveries to end the over! Sums up his day today, just not bowled the way he did in the first innings. It is once again on the pads. Lyon flicks it fine down the leg side and takes a couple.
FOUR BYES! Another waste of a delivery! Sliding down and it is quicker. Sarfraz has no chance of collecting it. It races to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
A waste of a delivery! Down the leg side, Lyon tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball once again lobs towards short leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
No turn on this one and it is a touch fuller. Lyon defends it out.

Howzzat? Not out is the answer to that question. The Pakistan players are frustrated but can't help it as there are no reviews left. Bilal tosses it up around middle, it spins back in. Lyon tries to play it with the turn but he seems to have missed it. The ball lobs towards short leg. The fielder takes it and appeals but the umpire shakes his head. By looking at the replay, it seems like Lyon had missed it.
Flatter on middle, Paine keeps it out. 12 balls more.

Beaten! Beauty from Shah. Gives this a lot of air and keeps it full around off. Paine comes forward looking to defend but the ball pitches and spins sharply away. The main thing though is that it misses his outside edge completely and Paine survives.

Rapped on the pads but not out. Paine comes forward to this slightly quicker delivery on off. He is playing for the spin but the ball goes straight after pitching. Luckily for the Aussie captain it takes the inside edge before rapping his pads. That saves him.
The Aussie skipper lets the ball go outside his off stump.
The inside edge again to the rescue. Paine looking to block this one on middle from the crease, the ball skids through gets the inner edge and onto his boot.
A bit shorter in length this around off, Paine goes back and punches this to covers.
Survives! Lyon again lunges right forward, reaches to the pitch of the ball and keeps it out. 18 more balls to go.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Well played Nathan. He prods forward on this fuller length ball on off and defends it by coming forward and smothering the spin.
Tossed up ball around off, good technique shown by Lyon as he comes forward and blocks it out.
A bit shorter this on off, Nathan looking to work it away onto the leg side misses it and gets rapped on his pads but not adjacent to the stumps.
Very full and flighted ball in line with the stumps. Lyon defends with his bat in front of his pads.
On his pads this and Paine wrists this away to square leg. That's the end of the over. 24 deliveries remaining in this Test match.
Good defense from the Aussie captain again as he has kept out this good length ball coming into him with ease.
Good length on off, gets behind this nicely and keeps it out from within his crease.
Better ball and a better defense. A good length ball on off shaping in, Paine plays it straight back.
This is what he does not want to do, straying down leg. The length is good again but the line is not as the ball brushes Paine's pads before going in Sarfraz's mitts.
Abbas starts this one with a shortish delivery around off. That makes it easier for Paine to stay back in his crease and block it out onto the ground.
Plays the over out! 30 more balls to play out for the Australians as Lyon defends the ball on middle.
BEATEN! Sarfraz would love this! The straighter one outside off, Lyon plays inside the line and gets beaten.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Bowls it short, not what Sarfraz would want. Lyon goes back and slaps it towards covers.

Tosses it up on the stumps, Lyon keeps it out. This is what he should be bowling all the time. No full tosses, no short balls, he just has to hit the perfect length in all the overs he will bowl in the last 5 left.
A low full toss and it has been pushed to covers.
Almost, Gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it. 36 more balls left. Pressure on both teams.

Big appeal for LBW, not out. Abbas again comes up with a beautiful in-dipper. He dishes this on a good length shaping in to the batsman. Paine looking to block it gets beaten and the ball hits his pads. The Pakistan players go up in a big appeal but the umpire immediately denies as the ball was going down the leg side. Interesting cricket, very interesting. Who says Test cricket is boring? Show them this match.

FOUR! Almost, almost! Kissing the leg stump perhaps. Abbas cleverly bowls an off cutter just outside off. Paine is beaten in pace as he hangs his bat away from his body looking to block it. The ball lands and turns back in to take the inside edge. The cherry goes past the leg stump and there was absolutely no gap between the ball and the leg pole when the ball passed it. A boundary at fine leg. Lucky Tim.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On his pads this time, Lyon flicks it through square leg to get three and get off strike.
Lyon won't mind this. He  lets the ball go outside his off stump.

Bottom edge, just bounces over the stumps. End result - the batsman survives, just. A yorker length delivery this, Paine looks to dig it out but gets a bottom edge. The ball bounces up and goes behind from over the stumps.

Big appeal again, not out again. Yasir lands this a bit outside leg from over the wicket, getting the ball to spin away from Paine. The ball however skids through and hits the Aussie skipper on his pads. The hosts go up in an appeal but the umpire shakes his head. No reviews left for Pakistan, however it was missing the stumps.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Paine is not letting any scoring opportunity go by, still. He again camps back to this shorter in length ball and again punches it through point to pick up yet another couple.
Shorter in length and a bit outside off, Paine punches this through point and takes a brace.

Big appeal for a catch at silly point. Paine survives. Yasir tosses this one up and lands it just outside leg. Paine comes forward a bit looking to block it. The ball though sneaks through, hits his pads and balloons to the fielder at silly point. An appeal ensues but the umpire correctly has given it not out. Seems the first appeal made was for the lbw but anyway, it pitched outside leg.
Well negotiated from Nathan Lyon, he survives. Abbas goes for the full in-swinging yorker. Gets it right on target but Nathan is good enough to dig it out.
Lyon has played that off the front foot and into the ground. Well played.
Another ball wasted. Similar to the previous one but this time it brushes Lyon's pads before going to Sarfraz behind.
Strays down the leg side. Nathan goes for the flick but luckily misses for Sarfraz to dive to his left and grab it. A waste of a delivery this.
Much better this from Lyon. Similar ball from Abbas but this time Lyon confidently comes forward and defends solidly onto the ground.
Attack the stumps must be the orders given to the seamer. He lands this on a good length with an inward shape on it. Lyon blocks it with a straight dead bat.
Mohammad Abbas comes back into the attack.
Wide down the leg side, no trouble at all for Paine who lets it be.
FOUR! Whipped for a boundary. Bilal tries the doosra and errs in line. Paine goes back and whips this, a bit uppish, very fine through the leg side to get a boundary. Runs are irrelevant now.
A bit short this on off, punched back to the bowler.
Comes forward nicely to defend it but gets an inside edge. Luckily for him the ball goes straight down.
Fuller again on off, Paine this time drives it gently to mid on.
Very full around off, too full in fact as Paine can easily block it out.
Like that! It is on the stumps and Lyon keeps it out.
On the stumps, kept out. This is what Lyon has to do, get bat to ball on every delivery which is bowled on the stumps.
Bowls it down the leg side, Lyon flicks it to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball on middle, Lyon pushes it to mid on.
Flatter and outside off, the batsman lets it be.
Tosses it up around off, Lyon keeps it out.

Beautiful bowling by the offie. Keeps it on a fuller length just on off from around the wicket. Paine from his crease plays for the spin. The ball though goes straight on to beat Paine's outside edge. Plenty of Oohzz and Aahzzz there. Very close. 11 overs more to go.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up ball this around off, Paine lunges forward in a solid defense.
Flighted and fuller this on middle and leg, turning further down. Paine offers his pads.
Goes back to this shorter in length ball and punches through covers to take a brace.

Another appeal for bat-pad at short leg, Not Out. Bilal tosses this up around off, Paine this time goes back looking to flick it onto the leg side, misses the ball and the ball hits his pads before going to the man at short leg. Stifled appeal is turned down as there was no bat there.
Another flatter delivery on off, Lyon punches it to covers. End of a double-wicket maiden by Yasir Shah.
Flatter and quicker outside off, left alone.
Nathan Lyon is the new man in.

OUT! Australia are now falling like nine pins! Two in the over for Yasir Shah. He was wicket-less in the first innings but now has 4. He has turned the game around on its head. What a bowler! Another leg spinner by him landing around leg and straightening from there. Siddle goes back and tries to flick but misses. He gets hit high on the back pad but due to him being so deep inside the crease, the umpire agrees with the appeal. Siddle walks back without troubling the scorers and the Pakistan players are on cloud 9. Why not? One would feel they are big-time favorites to win this game now.
Siddle defends it from within the crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Peter Siddle is the new batsman in.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH! A ripper! Do not go anywhere folks, this match is going right down to the wire. It is going to be very interesting from now. Yasir bowls this slow and lands it a bit shorter on middle. Starc goes back and tries to turn it into the leg side. The ball spins and bounces a bit extra and the southpaw is not able to keep his shot down. It goes to the right of short leg at a decent pace where Babar Azam is positioned. He flies across to his right and takes an absolute blinder. Great reflexes. Pakistan are celebrating. They are right back in it with a chance to go 1-0 up in the series.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A bit shorter again on middle and off. Paine tries to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Tossed up around off, Paine goes forward and blocks it out without much trouble.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Starc goes back to this slower and shortish ball around off, taps it into the point region and runs to the other end.
A bit too straight this from Bilal, Paine goes back to glance it to long leg and get a run to go off strike.
Almost got him. Yasir floats this one up just a bit wide of off. Starc lunges forward to defend but misses the ball to get hit on the body, outside the line of off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Starc goes on the back foot to this slower and shorter in length delivery and blocks it out. Two more to handle in this over.
Mitchell Starc comes out to bat.

OUT! Everything is right in the replays and Pakistan have finally managed to break the 220-ball stand. It's Yasir Shah, their star bowler, with the wicket. He delivers a flighted full leg spinner around off and it spins back in after landing. The southpaw goes for the sweep shot but surprisingly misses to get hit on the pads. It looks pretty adjacent as the Pakistan players shout out an appeal. The umpire raises his finger after thinking for a while. Usman has a clueless look on his face. He  has a chat with his skipper and then signals for the DRS. He has no other option but to go for it. So, the replays roll in. Snicko shows no involvement of the willow. The impact is in line and it is hitting the stumps. Three reds and the match has come to life again. But spare a thought for this marathon effort by Usman Khawaja. His technique against spin was always doubted but he has put everything to rest with this remarkable knock. Pakistan get a sniff now. 14.3 overs to go and 4 wickets remaining.
A review has been taken against an LBW decision. The batsman in question is Khawaja. Looks close this. Have Pakistan got a breakthrough?
Tossed up on of, pushes to mid on.

Khawaja goes for the sweep again but this time misses to get hit on the pads. The impact though is way outside off. Interesting point by Ramiz on air - Apart from the time when the tourists collapsed in their first innings, Uzzie has been on the ground at all times of this match.

Drinks. Australia on track to save this match. What a great effort it shall be if they do manage to do it. Last opportunity for Pakistan this, their bowlers need to come up with something special now if they want to go 1-0 up in the series. The final hour begins...
Paine stays back to this loopy ball around off, dead bats it to end the over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A bit too straight again, TP flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Flat and quick again, not much air given by the offie. Paine flicks it to square leg.
Much better from Bilal as he lands this a bit fuller on off, Paine though copes with it nicely by defending it off the front foot.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Usman cuts it through cover-point and gets off strike.
Again the Aussie skipper goes back to this flatter delivery on middle, flicks it to square leg. A minimum of 16 overs remaining now.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A bit too short again, needs to keep it a bit fuller. Paine goes back to punch this to mid on.
Similar length but a bit outside off, Paine cuts it to short third man.
Absolutely identical delivery and shot offered.
Tossed up and a bit short this, Paine punches it back to Yasir.

NOT OUT! Now we know why there was no excitement as Paine was in quite easily. Bilal tosses it up on middle, Paine strokes it towards mid on. He calls for a run and his partner obliges. The fielder in that position scores a direct hit at the bowler's end and appeals. The umpire takes it upstairs and the replays show Paine is fine. However, not sure if such runs are needed to be taken. A run out is the last thing you want at this stage.
Yasir Shah comes back into the attack.
Tosses it up on off, Paine defends it out.
A direct hit! It has been taken upstairs. Paine is the man in question but he seems to be fine.
Floats it up on off, kept out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A nothing delivery! Too short and outside off, Paine cuts it but finds the man at covers who makes a good diving stop.

A huge, huge appeal but the umpire is not convinced! No reviews left also. It was down the leg side, Paine tries to flick but he seems to have missed it. Sarfraz takes it and appeals but the umpire shakes his head.
Angles this in and then gets it to shape away. Khawaja defends it towards point.
A full toss to end the over. Maybe he was going for a yorker but misses by quite a lot. Paine flicks it through mid-wicket and takes three.
Attacks the off pole again, the batter guides it towards point.
Outside off, the batsman shoulders arms.
The away swinger this time from outside off, Paine watches it move away and leaves it.
Fuller around off, Paine pushes it to mid off.
Some extra bounce on that one! Floated up around middle, it turns back in and also takes off. Paine tries to defend but it goes off the inside edge towards square leg for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gives it air on off, the batsman prods forward and blocks it out.
Loopy ball on off, Khawaja times it through covers and gets to the other end.
Flatter around middle, Khawaja goes back and blocks it.
Slower through the air outside off, Khawaja goes for the sweep but he is a touch early in the shot. The ball hits the toe end and then rolls onto the ground.
Another ball left and that ends another over which has been negotiated with ease. Another 20 to go.
Just ahead of a length outside off, Paine pushes it towards mid off.
Good length outside off, the batsman watchfully lets it be.
Another length ball which comes back in from around off, Paine defends it back to the bowler.
Length ball again around off, Paine lunges forward and defends it to mid off.
On the pads, easily clipped away to fine leg for a run.
Paine skips down the track to this full length ball and pushes it back to Bilal. End of a good over by the offie.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gets on the front foot and blocks it near his pads.

INSIDE EDGE! Pakistan have no reviews left now. Asif bowls it a bit shorter than full length on off. Paine goes back on this and that could have been very costly. The ball spins in, and it seems to have taken a slight inside edge before hitting his pads. The Pakistan players go up in a huge appeal. They know this maybe their last chance to get back in the game. Skipper Sarfraz has a chat with the bowler and some of his players and then signals 'T'. Okay then, replays roll in and immediately show an inside edge. Not out is the Aussie skipper and he continues with his fight.
A review for LBW is taken. The batsman in question is Tim Paine as he is given not out and Pakistan have gone for the DRS.
Identical delivery and a similar defense by the Aussie skipper.
Very full and tossed up ball on off, Kept out easily by Paine off the front foot.
The offie, Bilal Asif, comes back into the attack.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
On the shorter side again, Paine manages to defend it. Abbas has to bowl full, that is where he is at his lethal pace. The length he bowled on this delivery won't trouble the batsman at his pace.
Back of a length on off, kept out.
Well bowled! It is that late inswing which got Finch and Marsh and the length is also fuller. Paine at the very last moment flicks it through square leg for a couple.

Aerial but a very, very tough chance for the man at short leg who is standing a a few steps back. It went like a rocket, it had to stick. Full and on the pads, Khawaja clips it uppishly and right off the middle of the bat towards Rizwan, the substitute fielder, in that position. He tries to get two hands to it but the ball passes him even before he could react. A single taken.
Back of a length on off, Khawaja pushes it to mid on.

Once again too full on middle, Paine easily negotiates it. Yasir has either bowled too full or a little too short. He has not hit the length he should on a consistent basis. However, there is still time for him to find his length.
Flighted ball on off, Paine strokes it to mid off.
Loopy ball on off, Paine blocks it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Brings out the reverse sweep again, plays it a touch fine this time but the result is the same as his last reverse sweep, a single.
Flighted ball outside off, Khawaja works it towards short fine leg.
On the pads again, Paine flicks it to square leg.
Perfect! Hits the length around off, comes back in a touch. Paine tries to defend but the ball goes off the inner half towards square leg.
A little too short, sticks into the surface. Paine has all the time in the world to go back and keep it out.
In the 5th stump channel, Paine knows where his off stump is, covers it and leaves it.
A huge appeal but it is going down leg! Another inswinger on middle, Paine fails to flick it and gets hit high on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Back of a length on off, Paine off the back foot pushes it to covers.
Mohammad Abbas is into the attack.
Uses his feet again on middle, Khawaja flicks it with the turn through mid-wicket for a run.
Now very full on off, Paine jams it out towards covers for another easy run. The skipper has now faced 100 deliveries.
Slows it up this time but bowls it outside off, the batsman makes a leave.
FOUR! Paine cuts and cuts hard! Slightly short and turning away. Paine tries to cut but the ball goes off the outside edge through short third man for a boundary.
Nicely reverse swept through backward point for a run.
Floats it up outside off, it turns back in. The batter works it to short leg.
Back of a length around off, the batsman camps back and keeps it out.
Another in-dipper on middle, Khawaja with the swing, flicks it to mid-wicket for a run. How easily he's playing a bowler who is swinging the ball back in at 140 kph! Brilliant.
Easy-peasy! Tails back in late but it is on his pads. UK flicks it away in style, through square leg and collects another couple.
A little too wide outside off, Khawaja need not play at those.
Back of a length around off, the batsman blocks it out.
Slightly shorter in length outside off, Khawaja uses the pace of the bowler and guides it through backward point for a couple.
Fires this on the leg pole, Paine with the angle works it to mid-wicket.

Nicely played! Yasir bowls a similar delivery to the last one, quicker and a touch shorter. This time he gets it to bounce a touch extra. Paine goes back, rides on top of the delivery and with soft hands plays it on the bounce to the first slip fielder. Very well done.
Flatter and a touch shorter on middle, Paine punches it back to the bowler. Too easy this for the batters.
Another tossed up ball on middle, Paine pushes it back to the bowler.
This time through the other side. Goes down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Gives it a lot of air but ends up bowling a full toss. Khawaja easily strokes it through the vacant cover region for a brace.
On a good length around off this, Paine blocks it out with a straight bat and from within his crease.

FOUR! Errs in length and line and pays the price. Fires this one a bit too full on his pads. The Aussie keeper flicks this through square leg for a boundary. 50-run stand comes up. Well played by these two. Another hour and a half to cope with.
Fast and full on off, Paine has played that off the front foot and into the ground. 300 is up for Australia. What a fightback!

No ball, again. Luckily for Wahab and Pakistan he hasn't taken a wicket on a no ball. He will not forgive himself if he does that. Needs to be careful as many teams have lost important matches in the past just because of a wicket was taken on a no ball. Paine defends it from within the crease.
Similar ball this, Khawaja again keeps it out from his crease.
Keeps this full. Also switching sides for the southpaw. Gets it to tail into Khawaja from around off. Usman does well to play it out with soft hands.
The left-arm quick starts the over with a full length ball around off from around the wicket. Paine eases it into covers coming forward.

Well fielded! Khawaja plays the conventional sweep this time, it is right off the middle again. It goes towards the backward square leg region. Ali in the deep runs to his left, dives and makes a good stop. Saves a couple for his side.
Slightly short and Paine takes full toll of it. He cuts it through point and the batsmen run three.
Flatter and on middle, Paine defends it with his bat ahead of his pad, the modern way of defending.
Floats it up on off, Paine stretches out and strokes it to covers.
Brings out his go-to shot, the reverse sweep, cracks it towards deep point for a run. That was really nicely hit, deserved more than a single.

Almost! This one was nicely tossed up outside off, it pitches and turns back in. Khawaja lunges and tries to defend but it goes off the inner half, uppishly but just out of the reach of the short leg fielder.
Yasir Shah to bowl from the other end.
Hits the length again around middle, Paine covers his sticks and keeps it out. A disciplined over by Wahab. He was lacking that today.
Better from Wahab! He has bowled on a good length and line in this over so far. Around off and shaping away. The batsman keeps it out.
A little too straight, Khawaja works it around the corner and gets to the other end. First run off the bat in this session.
Another good length delivery around off, Khawaja gets behind the line and defends it.
On a length again around off, the batsman defends it.
NO BALL! Riaz has overstepped. He bowls it on a length around off and it has been kept out. It was a marginal call, slightly harsh on the bowler.
Starts off with a length ball outside off, Khawaja makes a leave.

We are back! 31 overs to go for Australia to play out and salvage a draw, whereas Pakistan need another 5 wickets to win. Usman Khawaja and Tim Paine walk out to the middle and Wahab Riaz will start the proceedings. Here we go...
... Day 5, Session 3 ...

Pakistan bowled a lot better than the morning session and the second new ball brought them luck. However, they failed to maintain the same pressure in the last hour of the afternoon session. The current partnership has seen off 119 balls and with a minimum of 31 overs more left in the day's play, it's heading towards an interesting finish. Can Pakistan pick the remaining five wickets? Do join us in a short while to find out.

Yet another hard-fought session! Australia lost a couple of wickets soon after the Lunch break and when it appeared that Pakistan will once again run over them, the pair of Usman Khawaja and Tim Paine joined forces to steady the innings. A special mention for Khawaja, who has stroked a fabulous century and has largely looked unflustered. His presence is going to be the key for Australia in the final session.
Keeps it wide of off, the perfect ball for a batsman before a break. Paine is happy to pad it away and he starts walking towards the dressing room. THAT'S TEA.
Slower and fuller just outside off. Trying to get it spin back into the batsman but the Aussie skipper easily strokes it to mid off. Playing for Tea, definitely.
Better from Shafiq as he lands this a bit shorter than full length around off. Paine blocks it out from his crease.
Tim Paine shoulders arms to let that one through.
Fuller this on off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and wide outside off to start, left alone.

Big effort this by the young Australian team. This is now the most overs batted by them in the fourth innings in Asia. Really commendable stuff. Meanwhile, there is a bowling change. Asad Shafiq to bowl the last over before Tea.
A bit straight, attacking the stumps, Paine goes back and works it down the leg side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slower and fuller ball is driven towards the mid-on region.
Breaking news - Imam-ul-Haq has a fracture in his little finger and is out of the next Test match.
This one is down the leg side and TP leaves it alone.
Punched into the cover region off the back foot by Paine.
A bit shorter to start with on the middle stump line and turning into him, the southpaw works it nicely to square leg to earn a run.
The Aussie captain has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Gets forward and blocks this flighted ball on off.
Tossed up around off, Paine defends it easily. He is not taking any undue risk.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Give him the best reverse sweeper award. Yasir keeps it a bit short and outside off. It is turning into the southpaw who has committed to the reverse sweep. Usman waits a bit longer to play a reverse pull to deep point for a single.
Reverse sweep, his go to shot, plays it well but straight to the man at short third man.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Paine shoulders arms to this slow loopy ball outside off.
Imam has his left hand in the sling. We're told that he jarred his arm during a fielding effort before Lunch. Let's hope he will be fine soon.
The right-hander rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to covers.
Flatter and quicker on middle and leg, skids through and hits Paine on his pads who tries to flick but misses.
Paine punches this shorter delivery to cover-point.
Very full delivery outside off, seeing the line Khawaja goes for the sweep and connects well to get off strike.
Haris Sohail comes into the attack now.
Tossed up ball around off, Paine has enough patience to block it out.
The Aussie captain has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A bit on the shorter side this, Paine punches this into the cover region.
A very full ball on his pads is flicked to square leg for a run.
Goes back to defend this slower and short delivery on off.

FOUR! SHOT! The left-hander's elegance, just so beautiful. Yasir gives this air and keeps it around off. Khawaja skips down the track, gets to the pitch and handsomely drives it through covers to get a boundary off the first ball of the over.
Yasir Shah comes back into the attack. He is Pakistan's trump card and let's see whether he can provide the breakthrough before Tea or not.
Slower and shorter around off, Paine punches off the back foot to covers.
A bit flatter angling into the southpaw, Khawaja goes back and turns it into the square leg region to get a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up again but pulls his length back a bit, Usman goes back and keeps it out.
Tossed up on off from around the wicket, Khawaja comes forward in a solid defense.
The offie floats this up nicely and keeps it full. However it is a bit too full which allows Paine time to drive it to mid off and get off strike.
Switches to 'round the wicket for the left-hander and slants in a length ball on off. Usman sticks back and blocks it safely.
Another one down the leg side, it's been clipped away through square leg for a single.
Too full and down the leg side, Paine tries to flick but misses. Is Abbas tiring?
A touch short and outside off, shaping away a touch, Tim opens the face of the bat and guides it past the diving gully fielder. The point fielder has it covered though.
Fullish and angling into the batsman, Paine leans forward and defends it solidly. There is a silly mid on waiting for any mishit.
Wayward delivery. Short and angling down the leg side, Khawaja stands tall inside the crease and pulls it fine down to the leg side for a run.

Inside edge comes to the rescue. Paine again goes back to this fuller in length ball. Tries to keep it out off a straight bat but the ball spins and hits his pads, luckily for the Aussie skipper, after taking an inside edge. The hosts appeal but bail out as they know the fact.
Paine goes back to this shorter in length ball and tries to flick it but misses to get rapped on the pads. The ball is going down clearly.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Uppish but safe! Skips down the track and flicks it a bit aerially through mid-wicket. The fielder at wide mid on dives across to his right to stop it on one bounce. The aggressive intent is still there but he needs to be careful.
Similar ball, similar shot attempted by the Aussie captain but missed again. Bilal needs to start from outside off.
Starts his new spell with a tossed up delivery on middle. The ball lands and spins further into Paine. The right-hander goes back to flick but misses it as it passes his pads.
Bilal Asis comes back to roll his arm over.
The in-dipper this one on a good length but starting from the middle stump line. It reaches Paine on his pads and he flicks it to deep backward square leg to get a single.
Stays back to this shorter of a good length ball on off and punches it to covers.
A bit wider of off this, Abbas testing out Paine. The Aussie skipper plays it well by letting it go.
Paine doing it well here. He is watching the ball closely, bending low to defend this good length delivery heading towards the stumps.
Similar length but the line is better, around off. Paine again blocks it out from his crease.
A good length ball around middle and leg, angling into Paine, the Aussie skipper waits back in his crease and plays it towards mid-wicket.
Skips down and flicks this full length ball on middle straight to the man at short mid-wicket. 100 overs up. The Aussies need to play out a minimum of 40 overs still.
Tossed up around off, Usman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Quicker and a bit straighter again, spinning into Khawaja. The southpaw goes back and works it very fine onto the leg side to get a brace.
A shorter in length delivery this outside off, Paine camps back and cuts it through point to get three. The fielder at point has done well to chase it down and save a run.
Similar ball this, almost a yorker on the leg stump line. Paine defends it out.
Full and flighted on middle and leg. Paine prods forward, opens up a bit to keep it out.
In the channel outside off, Khawaja plants his front foot forward to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
A delightful cover drive by Khawaja but he fails to pierce the gap on the off side.
Once again uses his feet to walk down the track and defends it watchfully.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Walks down the track and then defends it off toe end of his bat to the leg side.
Fuller and angling away from the batsman, Khawaja drives it off his front foot to covers.
Paine has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Quicker and in line with the leg stump. The southpaw gets inside the line to work it fine on the leg side for a brace.

Run out chance missed! Flighted and full around off, it's eased to mid off by Paine. He calls for a quick single but Usman reacts a bit late. The skipper then sends him back. Khawaja turns to get in and by then the man at mid off (Azhar Ali) does well to grab the ball cleanly and has a shy at the non-striker's end. He misses and the replays show that the opener was just out of his crease. Khawaja survives.
Short of a length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.

Reverse sweep, for the umpteenth time by Usman. The southpaw maybe the best player of this shot as he is playing these from the rough and has not edged even a single one until now. The batsmen cross over for a run as the ball rolls through point.
Tossed up on off, Khawaja gently prods forward and defends it solidly.
The Aussie skipper has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A bit fuller and straighter, attacking the batsman's pads. Paine flicks it through mid-wicket to get a brace.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Paine comes forward and defends this good length ball around off onto the ground.
Fuller this on off, Paine  defends it from within the crease.
A good length ball on middle and off, played to mid-wicket.
Mohammad Abbas, the most impressive bowler today, comes back into the attack.
This time it is a bit wider and that allows Paine to go back and cut it through point. They take a single and the Aussie skipper will be on strike in the next over.
Loose shot captain, gotta focus! Shah keeps it a bit short and just wide of off. Paine goes for the cut but misses as the ball goes over his blade and into the Pakistan skipper's mitts.
A bit shorter on middle and leg line, TP defends it from within the crease.
Very full and flighted again, Paine comes right forward and leans to drive it to mid off.
Straighter and a bit quicker this from Shah, Paine flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Very full ball this on off, Paine looks to drive through mid off but gets an inside edge. The ball rolls towards mid on as it is a googly, turning in after landing.

Drinks. Pakistan have bounced back in the last hour by picking the wickets of Head and Labuschagne. Australia though are still putting up a fight. Their skipper along with the centurion, Khawaja, are looking to continue and go to Tea without any further damage. Pakistan, on the flip side, will be keen on breaking this stand and entering the hosts' tail as soon as possible.
It is outside leg again and turning towards the stumps, the southpaw covers his stumps and pads it away.
Khawaja comes forward and across to defend this full and flighted delivery outside off but the ball skids on and hits his pads.

Almost a mix-up, but safe. Khawaja pushes this to the cover region and takes a step forward. Paine responds immediately and starts running but only to see Usman stop. The Aussie skipper then fortunately manages to turn, without slipping, to reach back in his crease at the non-striker's end.
This time it's the conventional sweep to this very full ball outside leg. Usman connects well to get a brace.
A bit short and gives Usman the chance to go back and punch it through cover-point for a single.
Starts with a slow and loopy ball around off, Khawaja prods forward to defend.
Paine flicks this full and flighted ball to square leg with a wristy shot.
Full and flighted this on off, stroked gently to short cover.
Seeing this one a bit shorter, Paine rocks back and punches it to covers.
Very full on off, driven to mid on.

Good work at short leg. Not allowing Paine to get off-strike. The Aussie skipper goes back to this shortish delivery and flicks it into the leg side. It hits the short leg fielder and he does well to grab the nut.
Yasir, with his tail up, tosses it up and keeps it straight. Paine goes back and punches it back to the bowler.
Full and in line with the stumps, Paine works it through square leg to pick up a single.
This time he dances down and defends it by smothering the spin.
Good bowling this by Asif, Paine skips down the track but is beaten in flight as he is not to the pitch of the delivery. He offers his pads to this one.
FOUR! Errs in length and lands it very short outside off. Paine camps back and cuts it late through backward point. The fielder tries his best to stop it from crossing the rope but is unsuccessful.
Similar ball but this time, Usman opens his bat face a bit to hit the gap and take a run.
Bilal starts his new over with a very full and flighted ball on off, Khawaja drives it softly to short cover.
Beaten again! Top class bowling! A leg spinner around middle, Paine pushes himself on the back foot as he attempts to defend but it spins away viciously to beat the outside edge.

Calm down, skipper! He hurries down the track and then tries to defend. Slips in the process as it clips the inside half of his bat. Paine immediately turns to plant his bat inside the crease. The replays show that he lost his footings there, resulting in his spike scratching the surface even more. Not good for Australia. This pitch is already difficult to bat on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Paine has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Misses the off pole by a whisker! Paine leaves it alone thinking it will spin away but it skids through and goes perilously close past the off stump.
Flighted on off, defended off the front foot to covers.
A bit wider outside off and quicker too, Usman leans across and keeps it out off the front foot.
Similar delivery and similar respect and patience shown by Usman as he blocks it out.
Flighted and very full on off, the centurion lunges forward in defense.
Goes back to this slower delivery and turns it 'round the corner to get off strike.
Flighted and very full on off, Tim lunges forward in defense.
Tossed up ball on off this, Paine comes down the track to defend.

Fools the Aussie skipper with a googly. Paine is forward in defense without reading the variation and it takes the inside edge before running down to fine leg. A single to get off the mark. Not a convincing way though.
Loopy and on off, defended off the front foot.
Very full and on off, Paine digs it out to the off side. All of a sudden you can hear the noises around the bat. More energy in the field from Pakistan.
Floated full ball on off, it's pushed off the front foot to covers.
Flatter and on middle, defended off the back foot.
Skipper Tim Paine arrives in the middle. A captain's knock expected from him. Around 50 overs left in the day's play. Can he deliver?

OUT! Trapped in front. HALF THE JOB DONE BY PAKISTAN! Number five goes down for the Kangaroos. Yasir Shah delivers a flighted ball in line of the stumps. Labuschagne, instead of coming forward, goes back to defend it and that's the mistake he has committed. Misses the ball completely as the nut beats the inside edge of his bat to rap him right in front of the sticks. They go up in an appeal in unison and gets the desired response from the umpire as he raises his finger. The debutant looks at his partner and then heads back to the pavilion. No need to review that. Pakistan look pumped up now!
A bit short this and Khawaja pulls this through deep square leg to get a brace.
Tossed up on off this, Usman shows good temperament to block it out. It's necessary that he does not lose his focus after getting to the landmark.
Similar line and length on this one, Usman from the front foot just pushes it into covers.
Very full and flighted ball outside off, Khawaja lets it be.
Full and on off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Oohhh... that was very close to the off pole. A brave leave in the end by Khawaja. Asif serves it around off and this one skids on with the angle. Usman gets forward and then makes the leave.
Bilal Asif is back into the attack.
Tossed up ball landing outside off and turning back in, Khawaja brings out the reverse sweep and places it through point for one.
Lovely shot! Extra flight this time by Shah. He bowls it full and outside off, Marnus drives it with the spin through covers and takes three runs. Looking quite positive, the debutant.
Once again bowls it in the flatter trajectory, a bit short and on off, it's blocked off the back foot.
Flatter leg spinner landing on middle, Labuschagne goes back and hits it in front of short leg.
Quicker and fuller on off, Marnus gets forward and defends it off the inner half of his bat.
Aerial but safe! Loopy full ball landing outside off and spinning back in with extra bounce, Khawaja gloves his attempted sweep shot and it balloons over leg gully. A single taken.
Gets right forward to the pitch and keeps it out.

SIX! WHACK! Skips down the track again. This time he reaches to the pitch of it and swings through to heave this nut over the long on fence for his first maximum in Test cricket. Good shot! Ramiz Raja on air says - Are they going for the chase?... Interesting.
The debutant gets to the pitch of this flighted ball and defends it.
Comes down the track does Labuschagne. Does not reach to the pitch of the ball and hence blocks it out.
Full on off, stroked to mid off.

TEST CENTURY NUMBER 7! What a knock by Usman Khawaja, simply brilliant. He goes back to this shorter in length delivery on the stumps and works it into the mid-wicket region for a single. Labuschagne responds well and when he is about to reach the non-striker's end, the southpaw starts to celebrate. Jumps in joy and punches the air as he is just ecstatic to come up with such an outstanding knock. Must be right up there among his best knocks. Job not over though, needs to continue.
A bit shorter this and the debutant goes back in defense.

Reverse sweep again and he gets it right. Gets down to play the shot, takes the ball on the full and reverse sweeps it very fine through the third man region to pick up three and move on to just one run away from a ton.
Reverse seep attempted but missed. Usman, not surprisingly, goes for the reverse sweep but misses as this very full ball outside off sneaks under his bat into Sarfraz's mitts.
Usman gets right to the pitch of the ball to block it out.
Dances down the track, converts it into a half volley and eases this through to long on for a single.
Flighted and full on off, defended off the front foot.
Yasir Shah comes into the attack. The leggie has bowled 50 wicket-less overs till now, can he get one now?
Flighted and around off, Khawaja immediately comes down the track and blocks it with a straight bat.
Once again Marnus uses his feet to get down the track and this time he strokes it in front of mid off for a swift single.
Floated full ball on off, Labuschagne walks forward and pushes it with the spin to covers.
Uses his feet to dance down the track and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Much better this time. Leans forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Mishit! A tossed up ball outside off, Khawaja tries to play the slog sweep but gets a big fat inside edge onto the pads. Getting a bit too greedy here, Usman.
Pulls his length back and lands it around off. Labuschagne goes back and cuts it straight to point.
Loopy full ball on off, Marnus gets forward nicely and drives it through to mid off.
Flighted and full on middle, defended off the front foot.
Flatter and fuller on off, Labuschagne strides forward in defense.
Beaten! Sharp away spin with some extra bounce, Marnus hangs his bat outside only to get beaten.
Shortish and around middle, Khawaja reverse sweeps it through backward point for a single. Sarfraz is not impressed with the length Haris bowled.
Just tickles it off his pads through mid-wicket and retains strike. 9 from this over.

FOUR! And again. The new ball won't spin much and Usman is using that to his advantage. He shimmies down the track and lofts it nonchalantly over mid on for yet another boundary in this over. Moves into the 90s as well.
Walks forward to the pitch of the delivery and blocks it safely.
Khawaja has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Once again uses his feet, gets down the track and drives it through the line. Finds the cover fielder.

FOUR! Bang! Attack is the best form of defense. Khawaja wears his skates to rush down the track and powers it over mid on for a cracking boundary. Excellent footwork. It's important not to get bogged down here for Usman.
Flatter and outside off, Labuschagne reaches out for it and pats it down.
Uses his feet to get down the track and bunts it towards covers for a run.
Walks down the track and brings his bat and pad together in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Stifled appeal for an lbw! The ball is new so it will bounce more. Haris Sohail just lands it outside off, on the rough and gets it to turn back in sharply. Khawaja gets forward and across to defend but misses. He is hit on the pads but the impact is well outside off.
Shortish and wide outside off, Labuschagne goes back and punches it through covers for a run.
Haris Sohail to continue...
Around leg, Khawaja is on the back foot in defense. End of a successful over for Pakistan.
Khawaja has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter and fuller on off, Usman pushes it towards mid off. A bit uppish, that.
Off the mark in Test cricket! Marnus will be relieved after flicking it in front of square leg for a run.
Floated full ball on off, its' defended cautiously off the front foot by Marnus Labuschagne.
Marnus Labuschagne is in next. Big moment for the debutant. He bagged a duck in his first outing. How will he fare this time around?

OUT! What a masterstroke by Sarfraz! He immediately opts for the second new nut and gives it to Hafeez. The experienced campaigner has delivered and the Pakistan players are jubilant. The long wait for a breakthrough ends for them. Hafeez delivers it from 'round the wicket and tosses it up in the line of the stumps. Since it's a new ball, the ball skids through the surface, beats the bat of Head who probably was on the back foot waiting for the away spin. He misses it completely to get rapped on the back pad and the finger goes up immediately after the appeal. No need to refer that. This is very plumb. Head walks back with his head down. But a wonderful effort by him on debut. It also brings an end to the 132-run stand. Can Pakistan capitalize from here?
Second new ball has been taken. Who is making the first use of it? Wahab Riaz? No. Mohammad Abbas? No. It's Mohammad Hafeez.
Shortish delivery and once again it has been turned in the gap at square leg for one.
Play and a miss! Head tries sweeping this one off the rough but fails to connect.
This is now the best partnership for Australia in the fourth innings in Asia. Terrific effort. Khawaja this time skips down the track to a full ball and pushes it down through mid on for a run.
Flighted and full on off, defended off the front foot.
Allows the ball to spin back in and then nudges it through square leg for another run.
Starts with a short ball on middle and leg and it has been pulled behind square leg for a single.

Welcome back for the afternoon session. The players are already on the field and the battle of survival continues for Australia. Pakistan are continuing with the spin of Haris Sohail. Just one more over for the second new ball. Here we go again...
... DAY 5, SECOND SESSION ...

Pakistan were quite poor this morning. Their bowlers weren't able to apply much pressure. No doubt there is assistance from the pitch but they failed to hit the right areas on a consistent basis. Only Mohammad Abbas looked threatening in his spell. Apart from that, there was a moment when Pakistan should have taken the review but they decided against it, thereby giving a life to Travis Head. Altogether, a disappointing outing for them and they would have to come out with some different strategy after the break. Do join us in a short while for the post-Lunch session.

Australia's session! Tremendous application shown by Usman Khawaja and Travis Head. They braved everything coming their way in the morning session and have now extended their partnership to 128 off 284 balls. Both looked completely unfazed and dealt with the Pakistan bowlers with confidence. The pair has seen off 29 overs of the final day but the job is not done yet. They will have to continue in the same manner because if they provide an opening, Pakistan have the bowling to run through, like we witnessed in Australia's first innings.
Fullish and on middle, Khawaja pushes it with gentle hands to mid off and takes a run. LUNCH ON DAY 5!
Switches to over the wicket and serves a full ball on middle and off. Khawaja draws forward in defense.
Floated and full outside off, Usman lunges and defends it watchfully. Two more balls left for Lunch.
Shortish and on off, Head rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Flatter and on middle, worked from the crease to square leg for one.
Loopy delivery outside off, left alone.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.

NOT OUT! The impact indeed was the issue. A great delivery though. Sohail gets it to spin back in sharply from outside off, Khawaja is caught inside the crease as he tries to defend. But he fails to do so and is rapped on the pads. They appeal but the impact looks quite outside off to the naked eye. Still, Sarfraz consults his bowler before taking the review. Right then, the replays come in and they show that the impact is with the umpire's call. The review is retained but Sarfraz ain't looking too impressed.
Shout for an lbw! Not given. Sarfraz has a chat with his bowler and then goes for the DRS. Is the impact outside off?
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Superb shot! Sohail gives this one some extra air as he drops it on a fuller length outside off. Khawaja goes down on one knee and sweeps it firmly in front of square leg. Asif rushes across to his right from fine leg to make a nice stop. Two taken.
A bit on the shorter side this time, Head moves back and works it past the left side of the short leg fielder for a single.
Sharp delivery, at 92.5 kph, it lands around off and spins back in, Head does well to block it safely.
Slower through the air, full and on off, Khawaja presses forward in defense. Pakistan's long wait for a breakthrough continues.
Floated off spinner outside off, Khawaja strides forward to cover his stumps and then lets it through.
Well played but fails to find the gap properly. A shortish ball on off, Head gets inside the crease and plays a late cut. The backward point fielder does well to stop it as the batsmen cross.
Pitches it full and on off, Khawaja drills it down to long off for a single.
Flighted and outside off, Usman covers the line and leaves it.
Tossed up ball outside off, Head is drawn forward as he pushes it through covers for a run.
Bilal Asif is back into the attack.
Khawaja has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Allows the ball to spin back in and then nudges it past leg gully for one.

Howzzatt? Once again it's spinning back in from outside off, Head fails to sweep and is hit on the pads. The impact once again is outside off. Both the batsmen have been conscious to get away from the line of the stumps whenever attempting horizontal bat shots.
Full and on off, Head prefers to stay back as he keeps it out safely to short leg.
Turning back into the batsman from around off, Head is on the back foot in defense.

Shout for an lbw! There is turn from outside off, Khawaja gets well forward to defend but is hit on the pads. It rolls past the keeper and they steal a leg bye. There was an appeal but the impact was very wide outside off.
Haris Sohail is into the attack with Pakistan desperate for a breakthrough.

Four byes! Riaz has completely lost it. Bowls a wild delivery, way down the leg side, as if teasing his skipper and challenging him to stop this one. Head allows it through and it races wide past Sarfraz to fine leg for a boundary.
Slips a length ball down the leg side, the batsman fails to flick and Sarfraz dives across to his right to collect the ball. Very unimpressive from an experienced bowler.
Too short and wide outside off, easily forced through point for another run. Very wayward bowling, this.
Shortish and on off, played down towards backward point for one.

Flashes and misses! Loose, too loose by Travis Head. Just hoping he knew it wasn't a Free Hit. Riaz delivers it short and wide outside off, seeing the width, Head throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
Oversteps and bowls a no ball. It's outside off and Khawaja hits it square of the wicket on the off side for a run.
Shortish and wide outside off, Head cuts it off his back foot through point for a single. With Lunch approaching, this is the period the two batsmen need to be mentally switched on.
Abbas switches to over the wicket for the southpaw now. Angles across a full delivery outside off, there to be driven but Khawaja shows good patience as he leaves it alone.
An away swinger, it lands on a length outside off, Khawaja this time remains inside the crease as he lets it through to the keeper.
A good length ball outside off, Usman gets squared up a shade after moving across the stumps and then defends it on the off side.
Beaten! Brilliant bowling. Abbas gets some late movement on this delivery. Serves it outside off, Usman walks forward and across to defend but is beaten.
Once again Khawaja is free to move around and outside the crease with the keeper standing behind at his normal position. He drives a full ball through the line but finds mid off.
Full and outside off, Khawaja uses his feet to get forward and across before defending it to the off side.
Sarfraz Ahmed has gone back to Usman Khawaja. Mohammad Abbas to continue...
A length ball on off, angling in, Head offers a straight bat in defense. Very solid.

Plenty of movement there but Wahab fails to control his line. He serves it on middle and leg and it keeps going down the leg side. Head fails to flick and it goes off his pads to Sarfraz. He collects it with a dive to his left as the bowler lets out a hopeful appeal. Clearly missing leg.
Good line, this is where he needs to be. Tails a length ball back into the batsman from around off, Travis defends it from the back foot.
Nearly chops it on! Riaz delivers a shortish ball around off, shaping back in, Head stays back to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Wahab continues to struggle with his line. Sprays a fuller one on the pads and it's been worked away through square leg for an easy run.
Digs in a short delivery wide outside off, Head goes on his toes as he slaps it through point for a single.
Wahab Riaz is back for another burst before the Lunch break.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
FOUR! That's thumped! A half-volley this time by Abbas, an attempted slower one outside off, Khawaja leans forward and drives it elegantly through covers for a glorious boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a length around off, Usman defends it off his back foot.
Fuller and on off, driven off the front foot to covers.

Safe! Khawaja has his back leg inside the crease just in time. First up, it's a beautiful delivery by Abbas. He angles it around off and gets it to shape away. Khawaja is squared up inside the crease as he attempts to defend. It misses the off stump by a whisker and Sarfraz standing up is quick to take the bails off. They appeal and the square leg umpire goes upstairs. The replays show that Khawaja did take his back leg out but has it planted when the bails came off.
The umpire has gone upstairs for a stumping appeal. Has Khawaja left his crease?
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total. Another ordinary over by Yasir. Not finding his rhythm.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Probably a googly, landing outside off and spinning away a bit with extra bounce, Khawaja lets it be and Sarfraz collects it near his shoulders.

Advances down the track to a full ball and brings his bat and pad close to defend. Works it wide of short leg and crosses for a run. 100-run stand comes up! A big achievement, this. Next goal will be to get through to Lunch safely.
A bit on the shorter side, turning down the leg side, Head gets back to work it away but misses.
Full and flighted outside off, Head inside edges his attempted sweep shot and it quickly rolls towards leg gully.

An overpitched delivery outside off, it's driven square of the wicket on the off side and the backward point fielder rushes across to his left to make a tumbling stop. They cross for a run. Good effort there by Imam.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it watchfully.
Slapped away! Once again Abbas offers width outside off and Head plays a cracking square cut. However, he fails to beat the point fielder.
A length ball angling into the batsman, Travis is on the back foot as he offers a dead straight bat in defense.
Streaky! Width on offer outside off, Head pokes at it and gets it away off the bottom edge. It dies in front of the first slip fielder.
Fullish and outside off, Head slices his attempted drive and it rolls towards the point fielder.
Uses his feet to get down the track and forces it towards mid on for a run. That fielder continues to be quite deep.
Misses! Yasir serves it in the rough outside off, turning back in, Head moves away from the line of the stumps and attempts to sweep. Fails to connect and it goes off his pads to point.
Loopy and full outside off, Usman reverse sweeps it through point and collects a single.
A leg spinner on the shorter side. It lands around off and turns back in, Head uses the depth of his crease as he slaps it through covers for three runs. Showing good footwork, Head.
Walks down the track and flicks it with the spin to the leg side but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Gets forward and across to a full ball and eases it down towards deepish mid on for a run.
Head is beaten! Abbas delivers it slightly short around off and it shapes away after landing, Head rocks back to punch it away but gets beaten. Superb over by Abbas comes to an end.
Sarfraz goes back as Head will be on strike now.
The line is too straight this time and Khawaja tucks it off his pads through square leg for a run.
Pitches it full on this occasion, just mixing his length, Usman drives it off his front foot to covers.

Third play and a miss in a row! Abbas is getting it to move away from the batsman. Khawaja tries pushing inside the line from the crease but is beaten. The angle is such that the southpaw has to play at it. This is incredible bowling by Abbas.
Beaten again! With the keeper standing up, it stops the batsman from leaving his crease. Usman tries to play a length ball outside off but fails to do so.
Sarfraz comes up to the stumps.

Play and a miss! Abbas steams in from 'round the wicket and bowls it on a good length around off. Khawaja gets across the stumps and tries to defend but it straightens to beat the outside edge. By far, he has looked the most threatening bowler today.

Drinks break. An hour successfully played out by Australia without any casualty. There was just one narrow escape for Travis Head though when he was trapped in front but was not given out and Pakistan didn't take the DRS. Apart from that, the current Aussie pair has dealt with the situation superbly. Pakistan will have to be patient and also smart in their approach. Allowing easy singles has not helped their cause. They need to be creating more pressure.
Allows the ball to spin back in and just taps it down towards short leg.
Tossed up ball on off, blocked by Head with ease.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Turning down the leg side, Head tries to work it across but it seems that it has come off the inside edge. Falls just in front of leg gully though.
Square leg comes in now. Change in plan then.

Yasir is on the shorter side, around off and turning down, Khawaja eases it through square leg for another single. That gap needs to be plugged but Sarfraz is persisting with the fielder in the deep. Maybe, he is planted there for a top edge.
Flighted and around leg, Head works it with the spin through square leg for a run.
This one is angled into the batsman, Khawaja moves across the stumps and flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Beaten all ends up! Beauty of a delivery. Abbas serves it closer to the off stump line, Khawaja with minimum footwork pushes inside the line and gets beaten due to the away movement.
Good length delivery wide outside off, further moving away, Khawaja shuffles across the stumps and then lets it through to the keeper.
Pitches it up and outside off, Usman commits himself into the shot and drives it towards the short cover fielder.
Angles in a length ball on off, Usman walks forward and across before blocking it with a straight bat.
Right on the money straightaway. Bowls it on a length outside off, shaping away a bit, Khawaja allows it through.
Mohammad Abbas is introduced into the attack for the first time this morning. A slip in place.
Tossed up ball on middle, Head goes back and defends it in front of short leg. Imam there seems to have got hit on the helmet as the ball bounced. All fine though.

Walks down the track to a full ball and drives it back to the bowler. Shah picks up the ball and has an immediate shy at the striker's end as Head rushes back. Aggression shown by Yasir but then he smiles.
Loopy leg spinner around leg, Head fails to connect with his attempted sweep shot.
Tossed up ball on middle, too straight in line and it's been swept away behind square leg for one.
Nicely played. Head skips down the track to a full ball and flicks it with the spin to mid-wicket for a run.
First reverse sweep of the day. Full and on off, Khawaja gets down on one knee and sweeps it through backward point for a single.
Loopy and full on off, Travis stretches forward to keep it out safely.
Skidding back into the batsman from around off, a bit on the shorter side which allows the batsman time to go back and work it around in the gap at mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
Fires one in, full and around off, skidding in, Head blocks it off his front foot.
Loopy and full around off, Head is on the front foot as he jams it down.
Asif drags his length short around off, Khawaja camps back and cuts it through point for a run.
Jumps out of the crease to a full ball and forces his drive in the direction of mid off. A single taken.
Flighted and on off, driven back to the bowler to end the over.
Another googly, landing around off and turning away. Head tries to defend it off his front foot but gets an outside edge. It speeds past first slip and they cross for a run.
Lunges to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
A googly but on the shorter side, Head punches it from the back foot but finds the cover fielder.
Turning down the leg side, Head tries to sweep but misses.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended down in front of short leg.
Loopy and outside off, Khawaja strides forward in defense.
Just in front of first slip. Flighted and spinning away, Khawaja chops it down from the back foot.

Maiden Test fifty for Travis Head! A very responsible knock by the southpaw. Asif drops it short and outside off, Travis is on the back foot as he cuts it through point for a run. He has struggled against spin in the past but this knock will give him immense confidence.
Fullish and on middle, defended back towards mid off.
Tossed up outside off, Head pushes inside the line and gets an outside edge wide of first slip. A couple of runs taken.
Flatter and outside off, Head defends it back towards the bowler.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total. End of an eventful over.
Tossed up ball outside off, Head is drawn forward in defense but it takes the outside edge and runs wide of first slip for two runs.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Appeal for an lbw! Not given. Yasir Shah looks at his skipper and then walks up to his bowling mark. They have only one review left, so they don't want to take any risk. Flighted and full, around middle and leg, Head misses his sweep shot and is hit flush on the pads. They put in an unsuccessful appeal. Well, the replays later on show that it pitched in line, impact was in line and it would have gone on to hit the stumps. Aahh... Pakistan have missed the trick.
Drags his length short around off, Head goes on the back foot and pulls it down to mid on.
Fires it on middle and leg line. Turning down from there and Head fails to flick it off his pads.
A slip in place now for Yasir.
Tossed up ball in line of the stumps, Head moves back and works it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy and on off, Khawaja walks down the track and drives it wide of mid off for a single.
Flighted and full on off, defended off the front foot.

Huge cry for a caught behind by Sarfraz! Turned down and he is not going for the review. Hmm... Beautiful delivery. Drifting into the batsman, lands full around off and spins away. Khawaja is squared up in defense as he gets forward. It beats the outside edge, probably brushes the back pad as it goes into the mitts of the keeper.
Loopy and full outside off, turning away, Khawaja takes a stride forward to cover the line and then leaves it alone.
Spinning away with extra bounce, Usman stays back and taps it down on the off side.
Walks forward to a full ball and flicks it through mid on for a run.
Tossed up ball on off, Khawaja offers a straight bat in defense. No slip in place, strangely. However, there are two close-in fielders on the leg side, a short leg and leg gully.
Goes deep inside the crease and works it through backward square leg for a run.
Flatter and full outside off, Head tries sweeping again but fails to middle his shot.

FOUR! Another leg spinner but it lands outside leg and turns down, Head goes down on knee for the sweep but fails to middle it properly. It speeds past the keeper and trickles over the rope at fine leg. Given as a boundary. The replays later on show that it came off Head's gloves.
A loopy leg spinner landing on off, fuller in length, Head is forward as he defends it cautiously.
Spin from both ends now. Yasir Shah comes into the attack. He's wicket-less so far in this Test match.
Doosra. It skids through the surface, going on with the arm after landing outside off. Khawaja covers his stumps before making a leave. Wasn't too far from the off pole.
Extra flight this time, it lands full and on middle, Head opens the face and guides it towards cover-point for one.
Floated and full on off, Head presses forward and defends it with the spin. Soft hands.
Flatter and shorter on off, skidding back in, Travis goes on the back foot and plays it down to point.
Loopy and full around off, it's driven again but this time straight to the cover fielder.
Flighted and full outside off, Khawaja takes a step forward and drives it through the gap at covers for a run.
Stays low this time, outside off, Head does well to keep it out safely.
Back of a length ball landing on off, shaping back in a bit, Head jumps and defends it from the crease.
Too full in length and around middle, Khawaja flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
This one is served on the driving length outside off, a watchful Usman Khawaja shoulders arms.
Bends his back to go short around off. Khawaja keeps his eyes on the ball and then sways away at the last moment to let it be.
A length delivery just outside off, Khawaja blocks it solidly to the off side.

Wonderful delivery. A bit more zip and spin. Bilal pulls his length back just a wee bit. He lands it around off and Head is in two minds initially. Decides to go back to keep it away but it spins away to beat the outside edge.
Slower through the air, full and around off, Head draws forward and defends it near his front pad.
Fuller and on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Full and around off, Head is on the front foot in defense.
Extra flight this time to tempt the batsman. It lands outside off and spins away as Head allows it through.
Loopy and full on off, Head lunges and defends it to the off side.

This time Wahab bowls it way wide outside off, Usman lets it through to the keeper. Good going for Australia, so far. Pakistan yet to apply pressure. Their bowling hasn't been up to the mark this morning.

FOUR! There is some movement on offer but Wahab fails to control his line. Lands it around middle and it shapes down, Khawaja eases it off his pads and it beats the fine leg fielder to the fence. Consistency is lacking from Wahab.
Gets behind the line of the delivery, covers the movement and then defends it towards the cover fielder.
On a length around off, staying a touch low, Khawaja keeps his eyes on the ball as he blocks.

Lovely delivery and equally well played. A full inswinging ball on off, Head brings down a straight willow and forces it back past the bowler. The mid on fielder fails to stop it with a dive and a run is taken. Sarfraz ain't happy with the effort.
A good length ball on off, angling in, Head pushes it from the crease to the off side.
Targets the off stump, there is some extra bounce and Khawaja gets hurried up as he goes inside the crease to defend. Nicely adjusted in the end.
Tossed up ball on off, Usman is on the front foot in defense.
Slower through the air, full and outside off, Khawaja watches the line closely before making a leave.
Quicker and on off, defended off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy and full outside off, spinning away with extra lift, an easy leave for Usman.
A wayward ball down the leg side to end the over. Travis fails to flick it.
Play and a miss! Riaz serves it short and wide outside off, Head attacks it but fails to connect.
The line is a little too straight and Khawaja works it behind square leg for a run.

Lazy fielding there by Hafeez. A length ball on off, Head brings down a straight bat in defense and keeps it out. It rolls down the ground, Hafeez moves across to his right from mid on, tumbles but fails to stop it. A single taken. Sarfraz is frustrated but doesn't say a word for a change. Perks of being a senior player.
Angling into the batsman from around off, at 142.4 kph, Head is firmly behind the line in defense.

Back of a length ball around off, angling in, Head goes on the back foot and punches it down to mid off. There is no slip in place, only a gully. Waqar Younis (on air) feels that Pakistan should have one just to put doubt in batsman's mind. Good point.
Flighted and full outside off, Khawaja strides forward and presents a straight bat in defense. Solid.
Asif is on the shorter side outside off, Head rocks back and punches it to deep cover for a run.
