Good line, this. Tosses it up outside off, spinning away with extra bounce, Head watchfully makes the leave.
A little bit of drift on this occasion. Lands around middle and off, Head draws forward and works it off the inner half of his bat to short fine leg.
Too full and wide outside off, Head drives it firmly through the line but fails to beat Shah at covers.
More byes today! Flatter and fuller outside off, Khawaja leaves it alone and Sarfraz fails to collect it cleanly. It goes through his legs and they take a bye.
Bilal Asif to operate from the other end.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. End of a wayward first over.
Some extra bounce this time. It rises from a good length around off, Head is on his toes in defense this time.
Finally hits the right area. Bowls it full and around off, shaping in a bit, Head is forward in defense.
And again. Riaz is struggling to control his line. Slips across another full ball down the leg side. Travis once again misses out on the opportunity to tickle it away fine.

Four byes! Once again Wahab is direction-less. Sprays it way down the leg side, Head fails to flick and this time Sarfraz has no chance of stopping it with a dive. A boundary results. Also, this brings up the 50-run stand between the two. A vital, vital one. The duo joined association when Australia lost three wickets in quick time. Their job is not done as of now, they sill have a long way to go and the two out there will surely know that.
Wrong line to start the day. It's down the leg side, Head tries to flick but misses. A good early exercise for Sarfraz.

All set to get underway. Usman Khawaja and Travis Head are the overnight batsmen. They have batted nicely so far but it's a new day and they will have to start from scratch. Pakistan get into a quick huddle before spreading on the field. Wahab Riaz to begin proceedings.

Brendon Julian is conducting Tim Paine's interview. The Aussie skipper calls it a huge day and says that they have to dig in deep today. Praises Usman Khawaja and Aaron Finch for showing the way. On losing wickets in a clumps, Paine admits that it's worrisome and they are working to improve in that area. Reckons that the initial phase will be challenging and they will look to survive that. Praises the Pakistani fast bowlers for their performance last evening and once again admits that they have to bat really well today.

For Pakistan, they have to remain disciplined in their approach and more importantly be patient. The surface has plenty of juice in it and their bowlers are expected to dominate. So far, the likes of Yasir Shah and Bilal Asif have not left much impact in this innings and the virtual hosts will be hoping for a better show from them. Mohammad Abbas has been the most standout bowler so far and Australia will have to be wary of the threat he possesses with the old ball. Stay tuned for more updates.

Hello and welcome everyone for the final day of the first Test match in Dubai. We have witnessed some great action in the past four days and it has now all boiled down to Australia needing to bat out the day to save this Test match (winning doesn't look even a distant possibility currently). They have seven wickets remaining and the current batting pair showed a lot of resilience in the evening session on Day 4. More of the same will be required today and Justin Langer will be hoping for a fight from his boys.
... DAY 5, FIRST SESSION ...

It's a very demanding surface, offering plenty of spin and there is reverse on offer too. The Australians showed good temperament initially but will need more of that on the fifth day if they want to come out of this Test match unscathed. Needless to say, Usman Khawaja holds the key but he will need support from the other end. Do join us for the final day of this Test match at 1000 local (0600 GMT). Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

In reply, the Australian openers once again laid a strong platform. But on the score of 87, the devil's number struck the Kangaroos. Mohammad Abbas trapped Aaron Finch in front and followed it with the wickets of the Marsh brothers. Just when it appeared that we will witness yet another collapse, Usman Khawaja and Travis Head combined to build an unbeaten 49-run stand and took Australia to Stumps without any more casualty. The former, offered one chance in the 47th over but to Pakistan's bad luck, Asad Shafiq dropped the catch at first slip.

The day started today with Pakistan eyeing quick runs to swell their lead. Imam and Sohail did a good job up front and post that, the pair of Shafiq and Azam took it forward. Sarfraz declared soon after Lunch, setting a stiff target of 462 for the Aussies.

End of another fantastic day for Pakistan! They have stamped their domination on this Test match and are seven wickets away from gaining a 1-0 lead in the series. Once again their bowlers bowled superbly with the old ball, especially Mohammad Abbas, who picked three wickets in quick succession to demolish Australia's top half.
Goes back to this shorter in length ball outside off and punches it to deep point to get a single. He will be on strike first-up tomorrow morning. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 4.
Travis Head is not taking any more risks as this will be the last over of the day. He blocks this full ball off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Again a bit shorter in length around off. Head has defended off the back foot.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.

14th half ton for Usman Khawaja in Tests! Flighted full ball around off, the southpaw leans forward and drives it through covers to pick a single and get to his second fifty of the match, the first time he has achieved this feat.
Head goes to play at this wide of off delivery but misses it to get beaten.
Comes down the track and drives this full length ball through the covers. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Goes back to this slower and shorter delivery on middle, turning into him. Travis turns it away into the leg side with the turn, leg slip stops it.
This time he flicks this straighter delivery to mid-wicket.
Very full again but outside off, seeing the line, Head goes for the paddle sweep but gets hit on the pads.
Flighted ball outside off, Head comes forward and defends.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the back foot by Khawaja to complete the over.
Very full this time, around off, Khawaja tries to drive but it takes the inside half of his bat and rolls back to the bowler.
Poor delivery, short and wide outside off, Khawaja smashes it square of the wicket on the off side and returns for the second run. Moves to 49!
Flighted delivery but it's too full outside off, Head drives it through covers for a single.
Once again stands tall inside the crease and taps it down to point.
Flatter, quicker and shorter on off, Head goes on the back foot in defense.
Bowls this way outside off, Khawaja gets outside the line and pads this off.
Slower and loopy ball on middle, Usman flicks it to mid-wicket.

DROPPED! Should have been taken. The part-time bowler almost got a breakthrough. Sohail fires this one full around off, Khawaja goes for the drive through covers. The ball spins just that wee bit to take a faint outside edge and fly to the right of first slip. Asad Shafiq at first slip sticks his right hand out, the ball hits his palm but does not stick in. Khawaja survives.
Full and wide outside off, left alone by Usman.
Beaten! Keeps it fuller around off. Khawaja stays back to defend but gets beaten by the ball spinning away on landing.
Flatter and quicker from the part timer, Khawaja looks to flick but gets rapped on the pads.
Haris Sohail comes into the attack.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Beaten by a beauty! Asif fires it in a bit quicker around off. Head neither comes forward nor goes back and looks to block it with unsure footwork. The ball lands and spins away prodigiously to beat Head's outside edge easily. Better pace on the ball from Bilal.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Again a fuller length ball on off is driven through covers for a single.
Gives it a lot more air this time and lands it outside off, Khawaja drives a bit away from the body but makes good connection. Gets two for it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Slower and fuller on off, Head has eased it to mid on with the turn.
Khawaja dances down the track to this flighted ball on off. A committed effort by Bilal there to save runs for his team. They pick up a single.
Head goes back to this shortish delivery from Yasir, pulls it through square leg to change strike.
Flighted delivery on middle. Flicked to mid-wicket.
On a fuller length just outside off, Khawaja reverse sweeps it to deep point for a single. Seems like Usman is more comfortable with the reverse version rather than the conventional one.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Shorter again, Head rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They manage to come back for the second.

Goes for the sweep with hard hands, the ball lands on a length on off, bounces a bit more which induces the top edge. The ball skies up towards deep square leg but falls way short of the fielder on the fence there. Wahab runs across to his right, rather ambles across and then after the shout from Sarfraz, he rushes forward to pick the ball. A single taken. Khawaja survives.
Lands this a bit short again. Head is happy to go back and punch it through point for a single.
Better from Bilal as he gives this a lot more air and keeps it around off, Head lunges forward in a solid defense.
FOUR! Good start to the over! Bilal serves it a bit short and around off. Head rocks back to make space and crunches it through covers for a boundary.
Flighted and full outside off, turning back in, Khawaja skips down the track to smother the spin and defends it down.

Tossed up ball outside the off stump, turning back in, Head moves away from the line and then tries to sweep. Misses to get hit on the pads but the impact is well wide outside off. The ball rolls towards backward point and they steal a leg bye.
Allows the ball to spin back in from outside off and then defends it from the crease to mid-wicket.
Jumps out of the crease this time and then defends it with a straight bat.
Flighted and wide outside off, Head allows it through safely.
Full and flighted around off, Head sweeps it firmly but Babar at leg slip makes a good stop.
Full and way outside off, Khawaja goes for the sweep but fails to connect it.
Looking good here the debutant. He reads the length quickly seeing the length a bit short and punches it through covers for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shorter in length and punched into the cover region by Head.
Travis has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted ball outside off, Head has nothing to do with it.
A bit shorter in length spinning into Head, he gets across the line and flicks it through square leg to get a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Again skips down the track and gets to the pitch of the ball this time. Then caresses the drive through covers to get a brace.
This one is a bit wide of off, and full in length. Head dances down the track, looking to defend but gets rapped on the pads.
FOUR! Head finding his feet in Test cricket. Yasir bowls a long hop and lands it very short on off. Head gets back and across quickly to pull it through square leg for a confidence-boosting boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Khawaja watchfully defends this fuller ball by lunging forward and smothering the spin.
Khawaja has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Similar delivery and left alone again by Usman.
The southpaw lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Marginally shorter in length, Khawaja goes back in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Very full outside off, Head gets down on one knee looking to sweep but misses. The ball goes under his bat, hits Sarfraz's pads and goes straight to first slip. No damage done.
Similar pace and line but the length is a bit shorter. Seeing this Head goes back and turns it into the leg side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Much fuller and in line with the stumps, Khawaja strokes it with the spin to long on and gets a single.
Reverse sweep time, good connection but straight to short third man.
Loopy delivery on off, Khawaja skips down the track and drives it back to Yasir.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched from the back foot but straight to the cover fielder.
Floated and on off, Head has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! That's a much better way to play. He advances down the track to reach the pitch of the delivery and then drills his drive through covers for a cracking boundary.
Once again Head is looking iffy against the spinners. Very indecisive whether to play or leave. At the very last moment he jabs it down in front of the slip cordon.
Edgy! Poor stuff from the debutant. Asif gets it to spin away from outside off. Head needlessly chases and fiddles at it. Gets an outside edge past the second slip fielder for a couple of runs.
Goes on the back foot and works it against the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Bilal Asif comes back into the attack.
Similar ball and Head works it into the leg side with the spin yet again.
Fuller and slower in line with the stumps, Head leans across and flicks it towards square leg.
This time he gets the paddle sweep right. It can be a risky shot though with the leg slip in place. The ball flies past the right of that man there and the pair comes back for a brace.
Goes for the sweep to this full length ball outside off. The ball lands and bounces more than the batsman expected and this results in Head getting rapped on the pads, outside the line of off.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Slower and a bit shorter this outside off and spinning in sharply, Head somehow manages to keep it out off the back foot.
Khawaja walks down the track and and across. He plays a walking defense to the good length ball around off. Interesting tactics by the southpaw to get the bowler off his line and length.
A good length delivery this angling into the batsman's body, Head flicks this through mid-wicket for a single. They think of a second but rightly decide against it.
Keeps it in line with the stumps and pulls his length back a bit. Head stands back and defends it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
A bit shorter in length, tapped towards the point region.

FOUR! Cracked! A short and wide ball outside off and Head cuts it fiercely through the point region for a cracker of a boundary. He looks in a nice frame of mind as he earns his first boundary in Test cricket.
The southpaw has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller ball on off, Head leans forward and across and flicks it through square leg to get off the mark in Test match cricket.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it back.
Flighted ball on middle, it lands and turns further to miss Head and goes down the leg side. Sarfraz does well to stop it.
A bit outside off and shorter than full length this, Khawaja looks to play at it but gets a thick outside edge into the backward point region. They cross over for a single.
Tossed up ball around off spinning in. Khawaja lunges forward in defense.
Yasir Shah comes into the attack.

Drinks. Fantastic hour of play for Pakistan. They have managed to take three big Aussie wickets and will look to make further inroads before the end of play today. The Aussies, on the other hand, will be keen on not giving any more wickets away.
Lands it on a good length outside off and gets it to shape back in a bit. Head is back footed in defense and keeps it out off the inside half of the bat.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
In the channel outside off, shaping away, Head shoulders arms. Still on a duck.

Drops it full and outside off, Khawaja walks down the track and pushes it to covers. The fielder quickly picks it up and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Sarfraz fails to back it up and they cross for a run.
Serves it in the channel outside off, Khawaja watches the line closely before making the leave.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. Terrific line and length from Abbas. He has really impressed once again.
A touch short and on off, it's punched off the back foot to covers. End of a probing over by Wahab.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.

Not out! It indeed is missing leg. Wahab gets another delivery to move back in sharply from around middle and leg. Head leans across while attempting to flick but fails to put bat on ball. He is thudded on the pads, they appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. Sarfraz has a chat with his bowler and then goes for the DRS. The replays roll in and confirms that it's missing leg by a fair margin.
Appeal for an lbw, turned down. Sarfraz has a chat with his bowler and then goes for the review. Looks to be missing leg. Let's see...
Some swing in the air and movement off the deck as well. It pitches on middle and goes down, Head flicks it off his pads but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Angling into the batsman, Head keeps it out off his pads to the on side.
Good length delivery on off, Head gets behind the line and blocks it from the back foot.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

Leg bye! Abbas lands this a bit shorter than good length angling into Head, Travis tries to put bat to ball but misses to get rapped on the thigh pad. It rolls behind square leg and they cross for a leg bye.
Travis Head comes in to bat.

OUT! What. A. Review. It's hitting leg and Mitchell Marsh has to depart. Fantastic stuff from Pakistan. And it is still - 87. Abbas keeps it a bit fuller than good length. It has an inward movement to it. The ball lands and nips in further, beating the forward defensive push by Mitchell, thereby rapping him on the pads. Pakistan appeal but the umpire declines it. Seems not out to the naked eye but Sarfraz has different ideas. He chats with the bowler and his players before taking the review. The replays roll in and they show that the impact is in line as expected and hang on...it is hitting the leg stump. Three reds and Pakistan rejoice. You cannot make any better use of the DRS than this. Australia lose their third in quick succession and 375 looks farfetched now.
Review taken for an LBW decision. The man in question is Mitchell Marsh. Is it missing leg?
Defended off the back foot by Marsh solidly under his eyes.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

JUST SHORT! Would have been a stunning catch had that carried. An in-dipper again from Abbas in line with the stumps. Mitchell flicks it uppishly towards mid-wicket. Hafeez positioned there dives low to his right. Replays later show that the ball falls just short of him. Well tried though.
Ends the over with a very full and straight ball attacking the stumps. Khawaja defends it under his eyes.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Still on 87 are the Aussies. Full delivery around off with an inward angle into the southpaw. Khawaja blocks it solidly onto the ground.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Certainly it's reversing. Wahab serves it on a length around off, curling back in, Khawaja does well to defend it from the crease.
Great delivery to start the over. Angles in a full ball on off, Khawaja does well to block it at the last minute.
Out walks Mitchell Marsh with Australia once again slipping after a solid beginning.

OUT! And 87 strikes twice! It's called the Devil's Number for a reason. Two in the over and Pakistan are roaring loud now. Very, very loose this from Marsh. Abbas dishes this on a good length around off from 'round the wicket. The ball lands and nips away a bit. Shaun with no footwork feels for it inside the line and gets an outside edge behind. Sarfraz makes no mistake. He tosses the ball up in delight. Is this the start of yet another collapse?
The southpaw has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shaun Marsh is the new batsman.

OUT! REVIEW LOST! An in-dipper from Abbas, the one delivery he is an expert of. Lands this one around off and on a good length. Finch tries to defend it with his bat and pad together. But the ball hits the deck, deviates in and seems to have hit him on the front pad. Is it pad first or bat first? The Pakistani players go up in a huge appeal and the umpire immediately raises his finger. Finch, after some thought and a small chat with Khawaja, signals the 'T'. The replays show that it hit the pads first and it's in line of the stumps. Three reds and Finch goes, good Test debut for Finch. But Pakistan have got the all-important first wicket. Can they build on this opening?
Finch is given out lbw. Review taken. The batsman in question is Aaron Finch. Looks very close. Only some bat on it can save him.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Very full again attacking the stumps. Finch though looking to play it straight is early into the shot but manages to keep it down. Replays show it was an off cutter from Abbas.
Full length ball around off angling away from Finch, Aaron comes forward and drives it to mid off.
A similar ball around off. Finch defends it from the crease. The pair will look to end the day's play without any damage.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Completely missing his radar here Wahab. He fires this very full and down the leg side. Sarfraz does well to stop it from going behind him.
Marginally shorter than good length around off. Khawaja, with his natural attacking instinct, goes after it and punches it to covers.
Errs in line and strays on the pads. Finch flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Starts with a full length delivery around off and angling further away. Finch does well to defend it right under his eyes.
Wide of off, the batsman shoulders arms.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Fuller this and a bit outside off, Usman leans forward and drives it to mid off.
A good length ball around off, with an inward angle. Khawaja blocks from his crease.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Punch from Finch. He rocks back and punches this shortish delivery around off through the cover-point region. The fielder at extra cover gives it a good chase, dives and has pulled the ball back in play before it crosses the rope. The batsman gets three.
Almost chopped on! Short and wide this outside off, Usman goes for the cut but gets a bottom edge for no runs. No need to manufacture shots, this was not that wide to cut.
Straighter delivery on the pads, Finch flicks it through square leg to get a single.

Beaten! Lovely, lovely delivery from Riaz. Again lands it in the similar area around off but this time the nut hits the deck and moves further away from Finch. Aaron looking to tentatively push at it is beaten. This is good from Wahab as he is extracting something from this placid pitch.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Better and fuller from Wahab, around off and angling further away. Finch does well to account for the angle and blocks it off the front foot.
First ball of the over is angling into his body from over the wicket. Aaron flicks it off the back foot but straight to square leg.
A bit shorter of a good length. Not much movement as Finch goes back and keeps it out.
Khawaja shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A bit straighter this from Abbas as he strays on the batsman pads. Aaron gets on his toes and flicks it through mid-wicket to change strike.
A bit shorter in length this around off, Finch rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to cover-point.
Shot and stop! Finch crashes this short and wide of off delivery crisply. Imam at point dives well to his right to make a one-handed save and saves four runs.
Marginally short of a good length and outside off. Usman stays back and steers it into the point region to pick up a single.
Finch rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to covers.

FOUR! In the slot and driven for four! Looks like these two will continue playing their natural game. The right-hander goes after a full length ball wide of off. Makes lovely connection and the ball races across the cover boundary.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Keeping it tight here, Wahab. He again targets that corridor around off. Finch though has his eye in now and blocks it easily under his eyes.
Aaron has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Wahab starts from over the wicket and lands this good length ball in line with the stumps. Finch flicks it to mid-wicket with a wristy shot.
Wahab Riaz now comes into the attack.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Beaten! Good ball! He dishes this good length ball around off from around the wicket with an inward angle into the batter. Khawaja looking to play at it gets beaten as the ball lands around off and straightens just that wee bit to beat the southpaw's outside edge.
FOUR! Fantastic flick! Abbas fires this a bit full but angles it into Khawaja, targeting his pads. Usman flicks it beautifully through square leg for a boundary.
Gets behind the line of this good length ball on off and plays it to covers.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Starts the session from around the wicket and lands this on a good length around off, Usman blocks it from his crease.

We are set to get the final session of the day underway as the umpires followed by the Pakistan players are seen making their way to the middle. The unbeaten Aussie opening pair of Aaron Finch and Usman Khawaja too stride out to the center with the latter taking strike. Mohammad Abbas to start the proceedings post Tea. 24 overs remain in the day's play however, they will play till 1700 local (1300 GMT).
... DAY 4, FINAL SESSION ...

The Aussies though are still a long way behind and the two need to continue. Pakistan, on the other hand, will want to break this stand as soon as possible. The wicket is not assisting the bowlers a lot but the final session is the one where most of the wickets have fallen and the hosts will hope for the same. Join us to find out what will happen.

Australia enter Tea without any damage. As we mentioned earlier that they will have to take it session by session and they have managed to battle out one. Post Lunch, Pakistan decided to declare after adding some quick runs. The hosts then had around an hour and a half to go at the Aussie batters but their bowlers were negotiated easily. Finch and Khawaja have provided another decent start.
And it has been played out, like most of the balls in this session, EASILY! Finch goes back and defends it. TEA ON DAY 4!
Flatter on off, Finch defends it onto the ground. Last ball of the session coming up...
Loopy ball on off, it has been kept out.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Changes to over the wicket and bowls it around off, it is kept out towards cover for a run.
Goes for another reverse sweep, this time though he does not get it off the middle and it goes through covers for a brace.
On the pads, Finch pads it away.
Another floaty delivery around off, the batsman blocks it.
FOUR! Moves onto one short of 40. It is on the pads, Finch sweeps it fine down the leg side and bags another boundary.
Slightly shorter on the pads, Finch tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Too easy, not a lot of spin, no bounce. Finch gets onto the front foot and defends it.
Another delivery which is tossed up around off, it has been defended.
Very full on middle, it is stroked down to long on for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The googly, one delivery which he bowls very rarely. Finch lunges and defends it.
Quicker and shorter outside off, Finch finds the man at covers with the cut.
Another loopy ball on off, it is blocked out.
Tosses it up on middle, Finch defends it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Loopy ball around off, Khawaja keeps it out.

FOUR! Nice and late! Khawaja rocks back quickly, there is width on offer outside off, not a lot but enough for UK to cut it. He does so very late and through backward point for a boundary. He moves onto 29.
Bowls it flatter around off, UK defends it off the back foot.
Another tossed up ball around off, it is stroked to covers.
From around the wicket comes Bilal. He tosses it up around off, Finch shuffles across and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Close shave! Yasir floats it up outside off, it pitches and turns back in. Khawaja tries to defend but the ball goes off the inner half, uppishly towards the backward square leg region.
Flighted ball outside off, UK with the turn works it around the corner for a run.
A little too full now and Finch strokes it down to long on for a run.
Good leave! Yasir bowls a loopy ball around off, Finch goes back, covers his off pole, sees the ball is turning away and then leaves it.
Floats it up on off, Finch lunges and blocks it.
With the turn, Khawaja flicks it through square leg for a run.
A little turn but the line is wrong. It is down the leg side, Finch once again nudges it fine down the leg side and the batsmen run two.
Swept nicely! It is down the leg side, Finch sweeps it fine and takes two.
On the shorter side, Finch goes back and punches it to the bowler.
Flatter and shorter on off, Finch keeps it out.
On the shorter side, UK goes back and cuts it towards point. Shah there dives to his left and makes a good stop. Can't stop the run though.
Tosses it up outside off, Khawaja does the right thing by letting it go.
Aaron has played that full length ball off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Reverse sweeps this time through the point region for a single. Khawaja bringing all the shots out from his bag. Needs to be careful though, there is rough just where the ball is landing.

FOUR! Some aggression from the southpaw. He dances down the track to this loopy delivery on middle and off turning into him. Does not quite get to the pitch of the ball but still goes ahead with the shot. Whacks it with the spin over mid-wicket and has enough gas on it to cross the boundary there. Good this from the Aussies as the 50-run opening stand comes up.

They will get such balls to score the runs off. Hence there is no need to play shots off the good balls. Finch goes back to this shorter delivery outside off. Punches this through cover-point for a single.
Flighted and full delivery on off, Finch comes forward in defense.
Outside off, left alone. Another over negotiated with ease.
Gives it nice amount of air around off, Khawaja pushes it to covers.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On the stumps, UK gets right behind the line of the ball and blocks it out.
BEATEN! A needless shot that from Khawaja. It is short and outside off, bowled a touch quicker. Khawaja tries to cut but once again is beaten by the extra bounce.
It is floated up outside off, a similar delivery to which Marsh got out to. Khawaja goes for the drive but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Nice shot! Floats it full and outside off, Finch strokes it through covers and the batsmen bag a brace.
Brings out the sweep shot but mistimes it towards deep square leg for a run. Actually it was off the body as the umpire has signaled a leg bye.
Sharp turn there! Floats it up outside off, it pitches and comes back in. Khawaja does well to get outside the line of off as he tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.
Down the leg side, Finch flicks it towards fine leg for three.
Connects well with the reverse sweep but there is a man in the deep point region. A single.
Flatter around off, the batsman goes back and keeps it out.
Gives it a nice loop around off, Finch lunges and blocks it onto the ground.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted ball around off, it turns back in. Finch tries to defend but the ball goes off the inner half towards short leg.
Strokes it with the turn to the man at mid on.
Tossed up again, it has been blocked out again.
Tosses it up on the pads, Finch tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Shorter in length, Khawaja goes back and keeps it out. Batting seems easy out there at the moment. Not a lot of turn, no extra bounce. Both the openers are looking well-settled.
Eases it down to long off for a run.
Another loopy one on off, Finch is happy to defend it out.
Cracked but finds the fielder at covers! Yasir tosses it up wanting Finch to go over the top. Aaron does go hard at it but hits it along the ground towards covers.
Gives it a nice loop around off, Finch lunges and defends it onto the ground.
Very full on middle, Finch jams it out.
Yasir Shah is back on. Change of ends for him.
A good delivery to end the over! Bilal floats it up on off, it has been kept out. So not a lot of purchase off the surface for him as well. Maybe because the ball is still fairly new.
Flatter around off, the batsman guides it to point.
On the pads, Finch tucks it around the corner for a run.
A little too full so the turn is out of contention. The batsman strokes it through covers for a run.
Another one which is tossed up but slightly short. Khawaja cuts it towards point.
Starts off with a loopy ball around off, it pitches and then turns a touch. Khawaja defends it.
Bilal Asif is into the attack. The star of the first innings is brought on. Can he do something similar?

Drinks. So a decent start by the Aussie openers yet again. They have looked pretty comfortable handling the new hard ball. It will be interesting to see how they cope when spin will be introduced from both ends. Pakistan will continue to attack and try to pick some quick wickets after the break.
On the pads again, Finch flicks it through square leg for a single.
Fuller in length on the pads, the batsman flicks it towards fine leg and gets to the other end.
Similar delivery to the first one. Khawaja again cuts. The timing is better this time but he cannot find the gap, straight to point.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On a good length coming back into the southpaw with the angle. Khawaja gets inside the line of the delivery and plays it through mid-wicket.
Dishes a short and wide ball outside off. Khawaja goes for the cut. Mistimes it as it seems to have hit the bottom part of his bat.
A slower and shorter one. Allows the southpaw to play it through point and get a single to retain strike.
Very full ball outside off, targeting the rough out there. It is too full though as Khawaja comes forward and smothers the spin.
Errs in length this time as he drags it short turning away. Finch rocks back and punches it to covers for a run.
Brings out the conventional sweep this time, connects it well through square leg to get off strike.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Reverse sweep on the very first ball of a new over from the leggie. He keeps it full and outside off. Usman goes for the reverse sweep but misses to get hit on the body.
Keeps it on a good length but on the leg stump line. It would be difficult for him to get an LBW decision in his favor from this angle. Finch keeps it out from the crease.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.

FOUR! Class written all over that shot! Riaz again fires a very full ball outside off, it's just that bit overpitched. Allows Finch to drive it all along the ground through the cover region for a cracking boundary.
Good length delivery on off, pushes to covers.
A bit too wide of off this for even Finch to go after it.
Starts from over the wicket and dishes out a full and wide of off delivery. Finch being Finch goes after it and strokes it through covers. The fielder there has made a good stop diving to his left.
Wahab Riaz gets a chance to roll his arm over.
Ends the over with a low full toss on middle, Finch eases it down to long on for a run.
Again, slightly fuller than he should be. Finch lunges and defends it onto the ground.
Flighted ball around off, Finch easily defends it. Yasir maybe bowling a little too full here.
Another loopy delivery on the stumps, Finch blocks it out easily.
Slower through the air on middle, the batsman keeps it out.
Well bowled! Tosses it up around off, it pitches and turns away. Finch lets it be.
A fuller length ball is driven straight to mid off.
Similar length but on off this, Usman is happy to tap it from his crease to covers. Not much there for the pacers, apart from the extreme heat.
Attacks the stumps this time and lands it on a good length, Khawaja blocks it onto the leg side.
Way wide of off to entice the southpaw to play at it, left alone.
Bouncer! Bangs it in short, Abbas and keeps it in line with the stumps, Finch is happy to pull it to deep square leg all along the ground and get off strike.
Good delivery first up as he continues hitting the area of uncertainty. Finch blocks it out from the crease.
Khawaja uses his feet again and works it to mid-wicket. So that ends Yasir's first. Quite easily he was negotiated, the left-hander did not look troubled as the ball was skidding onto the bat.
Now with the turn works it to short leg.
Gives it air outside off, turning back in. Khawaja blocks it.
FOUR! Innovation and it has come off really well. How controlled was that? Gets into position early and plays the reverse sweep through backward point and the ball races away.
Dances down the wicket and strokes it past Yasir towards mid off.
Tosses it up around off, the batter defends it out.
Yasir Shah is brought into the attack. The leggie did not take a wicket in the first innings but one would expect him to be amongst them in this one.

FOUR! Ill directed full length delivery, way down the leg side. Maybe he went for the in-dipping yorker on the last ball of the over. His intent was to take the batsman by surprise. However, he strays this down the leg side. Finch tries to flick it and gets sufficient amount of bat on it to run it down to the fine leg region for a boundary.
A bit shorter this on middle and off, Finch plays it through mid-wicket.
Solid defense from Finch again. Looks solid, the right-hander, may be the confidence from the first innings is helping him in the second.
Finch has defended this good length ball on off by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another similar delivery probing away on that spot there, Finch is good enough to block it from within his crease.
Attacking that corridor of uncertainty, exactly where the batsmen do not want the nut to land. Finch though does well to keep it out.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Now goes back to this slightly shorter in length ball on off, pushes this into the cover-point region.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and drives this through mid on for a single.
Usman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. They pick up a single as the ball rolls into the gap at point.
A bit short again, Hafeez needs to give it a bit more air if he wants to extract anything from the wicket with this hard new ball, Khawaja punches this off the back foot to covers.

FOUR! Cut and cut handsomely. Usman rocks back and across as soon as he sees the ball a bit shorter in length and outside off. He brings out the cut and finds the gap in the point region for the second boundary of the innings.
Aaron shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Comes on the front foot to this fuller ball on off, not much movement on offer for the pacer, Finch keeps it out easily.
Finch has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Fuller and a bit more width for the attacking opener to play with, he drives this through the covers, standing almost a foot outside his crease maybe helping him to counter some movement. The connection on that drive is good enough as the ball crosses the boundary even though the fielder chased it hard and tried his best to stop it.
A bit shorter in length delivery to start his second over, the line is outside off and that means Finch rocks back and punches it to covers.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Swept fine and fine enough for the first boundary of the fourth innings. A very full and quick ball outside leg, Khawaja does really well to get some bat on it and sweep it fine of the fielder at short fine leg to cross the boundary.
Charges down the track does Khawaja and almost yorks himself as he mistimes it back to Hafeez.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Similar ball, Khawaja again prefers to stay back and see what the ball is doing after landing before blocking it.
Hafeez bowls it a bit quicker and on middle and off, Khawaja decides to go back and keep it out.
Mohammad Hafeez to bowl from the other end.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Close again, Abbas fires this on a fuller length attacking the stumps, Finch again looking to defend with his bat in front of his pads but gets an inside edge towards the deep square leg region for a brace.

Huge appeal for LBW, turned down. Abbas is on the money from the very first ball. He dishes this good length ball around off. It is on a line and length which confuses the batsman whether to come forward or stay back. Due to this Finch tries to block it from his crease. The ball pitches and nips back in to rap the right-hander on the front pad. Pakistan go up in a huge appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The angle might just take it down leg.
This is better from Abbas, he is attacking the middle stump line on a good length. Finch defends with a dead straight bat off the front foot.
Straighter this attacking the stumps, may be a bit too straight as Finch flicks it to mid-wicket.
Starts with a good length ball just outside off, it keeps moving further away on hitting the deck. Finch is happy to let it go.
